resources.title: Multi-Stage Dockerfile Template (Node + nginx pattern)
resources.description: A fully-commented multi-stage Dockerfile for Northbridge's checkout API: a build stage with the full Node toolchain, a slim node:20-slim runtime stage that copies out only the compiled dist/, a non-root USER, and a HEALTHCHECK. Swap the npm commands for your own stack's build/run steps and keep the shape.

resources.title: .dockerignore Template
resources.description: A real .dockerignore covering the cases that actually matter: node_modules (reinstalled fresh inside the image), .git, .env and secrets/ (never let these reach an image layer), build output, editor cruft, and test files. Pairs directly with the Dockerfile template's non-root, slim-base approach.

resources.title: Multi-Service docker-compose.yml: catalog, checkout, catalog-db
resources.description: A complete local dev stack for Northbridge's storefront -- three services wired together exactly as Chapters 5-7 build them up: named volume for catalog-db, health checks with depends_on: condition: service_healthy, restart: unless-stopped, env_file + Compose secrets for the database password, and resource limits/read_only/cap_drop hardening on every service.
